scope: Small follow-up investigation of Grid and Detailed after user accepted progress; Brief remains the smoothest by live feedback
normalTiming: Two independent Wayland processes per view per cohort; same 1800x900 window, 300 PNGs, three-second trajectory; steady state excludes first 500 ms; config isolated, OS and data caches retained

controls.inactive-backdrop-control: TranslucentSurface.sourceRect returns an empty rectangle when inactive or blur is disabled
controls.hidden-hover-anchor-control: File/Folder hover cards use a neutral anchor while invisible; baseline TranslucentSurface restored

decision: Neither control showed a consistent improvement in steady p95/p99/max; both reverted. Small samples cannot establish exact performance equivalence.
